body.name: \(L_n\) and \(U_n\)
body.construction:
For nonempty \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}\), order every coefficient, weight, and atom coordinate as displayed in the sieve definitions, choose the coordinatewise lexicographically least minimizer and maximizer of \(\mu_{\theta}(a)\), and set
\[
 L_n(a)=\max\{-B_Y,\inf_{\theta\in\Theta_{n,\alpha}}\mu_{\theta}(a)-b_{\mu,n}\},
 \qquad
 U_n(a)=\min\{B_Y,\sup_{\theta\in\Theta_{n,\alpha}}\mu_{\theta}(a)+b_{\mu,n}\}.
\]
If \(\Theta_{n,\alpha}=\varnothing\), set \(L_n(a)=U_n(a)=0\) for every \(a\in I\). Compactness and deterministic tie-breaking specify the extrema as jointly sample-and-index measurable selections; endpoint ordering is a property to be proved from the outer-sieve constraints rather than imposed by this definition.
